scope: Public/generated mechanism and semantic-adapter qualification before bank spending
truth: Keep mechanism/latent/graph/effect oracles outside model prompts; independent reference calculations.
split_unit: Mechanism family, with repeated samples, descriptions and prompts nested; no graph-family reuse across development/final evaluation.
arms: Data-only FCI under allowed latent confounding
Score search and non-Gaussian methods only within matched assumptions
Hard guidance with refusal and inconsistency traces
crossed_controls: Natural, neutral renamed and deliberately misleading labels with declared fixed-world semantics
No retrieval, applicable originals, wrong-domain and contradictory retrieval
Variable/order paraphrases and bounded repeats; identical numerical data and sample-budget comparison
metrics: Conditional identified effect-set retention/width and loss under known truth
Action regret and availability including refusal/error denominators
Tokens, retries, latency, numerical resources and human review
mandatory_adapter_cases: Token variants and missing mass remain explicit; token score not scientific confidence
Absent edge versus absent path in a three-node chain
Preserve CPDAG/PAG endpoint distinctions and return all failed requests
registration_before_final_runs: Pin implementations, environment, rights and backend revision
Freeze all targets, splits, sample sizes, repeats and numerical tolerances
Use development profiling only to set resource caps; declare fixed stopping and budget
Freeze primary paired mechanism-level comparisons and multiplicity treatment
success: Scoped information/decision benefit versus matched baseline under predeclared risk/cost limits; no generic LLM superiority claim.
economic_limit: USD6 per decision is an illustrative perfect-information upper bound at assumed world probability0.9, not an experiment value or bank budget.
